remarks: Discover a unique opportunity to own the perfect investment property in the desirable Waterside neighborhood of Stamford. This two-family home offers exceptional versatility and potential.  The front unit has the feel of a single-family colonial, featuring a spacious layout with a large living room, formal dining room, huge kitchen, and a cozy family room. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms two full bathrooms and washer & dryer combo. The unit also includes a basement, perfect for additional storage or potential use.  The second unit, accessible via a private side entrance, offers a well-designed layout with four rooms, including two bedrooms and one bathroom, washer and dryer in Kitchen making it ideal for tenants or extended family.  Don't miss this incredible opportunity to invest in a property with abundant space and charm, all in a sought-after location.
